n: Harvard Imperiia Teach the Watermelon Rebellion
t: A history lesson that uses AI-generated images to study the 1796 Kherson rebellion.
steps: Open the lesson on Harvard Scalar.
Choose Prompt A, B, or C for your class.
Choose an image generator for Prompt A and check that the school allows it.
Look at the pre-generated galleries with students.
Discuss what the AI got wrong.
